claims.claim: SQM links lithium extraction/conversion to battery supply for transport and stationary storage; BESS broadens the demand bridge beyond BEVs.
Diversification can reduce concentration, but added capacity shifts bottlenecks toward cost-curve position, conversion execution and demand absorption.

factors.name: bottleneckControl
factors.basis: Resource access matters, while conversion economics and demand absorption become successor constraints.

factors.name: supplyChainResilience
factors.basis: Geographic diversification can reduce single-jurisdiction dependence if projects execute economically.

risks.risk: Capacity growth can outrun demand and compress lithium economics despite volume growth.

causalEdges.falsifier: demand growth persistently trails supply growth below economic thresholds

causalEdges.mechanism: supply availability can pressure prices and margins
causalEdges.falsifier: demand absorption keeps utilization and pricing structurally healthy

unknowns.unknown: Normalized full-cycle lithium price/margin and project cost-curve position.

claims.claim: Current earnings strength is lithium-price sensitive and should not be treated as normalized cycle economics.
Production flexibility improves resilience but does not prove persistent pricing power.

factors.name: pricingPower
factors.basis: Commodity supply/demand remains a major determinant of realized economics.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: BESS can diversify demand while oversupply and project execution remain material.

risks.risk: Commodity-cycle compression and capex/commissioning risk can reduce returns.

causalEdges.mechanism: supply growth can pressure realized lithium pricing
causalEdges.falsifier: sustained demand absorbs new supply while SQM retains low-cost economics

contradictions.claim: Strong realized pricing/earnings coexist with slower BEV growth and production-flexibility emphasis.
contradictions.resolution: This limits mechanical extrapolation but does not establish present impairment because BESS and other demand can offset mix changes.

unknowns.unknown: Project funding burden, normalized cost curve and BESS-demand durability.
